purpose: small sanitized reliability publication index; no new run, fetch, database, build or publication
common_limits: Pins are inspected historical identities, not a new latest-version check.
Independent review acceptance has the stated scope only and is not an upstream endorsement.
Unpublished receipt hashes are identifiers, not public downloadable artifacts or authenticity signatures.
No aggregate speedup, bug total or test count is computed across heterogeneous evidence.
Raw traces, journals, caches, filesystem paths, process logs, credentials and complete source bundles are not publication payloads.
This index is not merged/deployed behavior and does not authorize a new remote write.

entries.title: Actual Core SessionStore growth/ownership observations
entries.accepted_scope: Authored fresh-session probes exercised unchanged public SessionStore boundaries on both pins: initialized-writer lifetime, rejected-append rollback and bounded history growth/repeated strict projections.
not_established: Requested allocator bytes are cumulative allocation/reallocation requests, not RSS, bytes copied or validator-only cost.
Whole-call elapsed observations include durable sync and shared-host noise; dev profile and small sequential samples do not establish causal speedup, p95 or production latency.
Canonical fact frequency is not per-token write frequency; functional controls do not cover power loss or in-flight cancellation.
The historical current-control report predates the separate accepted native-cache run; keep both chronology and scopes.

entries.title: Native cached conversation versus strict canonical read
entries.accepted_scope: Authored public-API CI fixtures observed cache fallback/invalidation correctness and distinct successful exact-owned-path open patterns for native snapshot, strict projection and schema-invalid fallback.
entries.consumer: Read-only conversation consumers choosing an existing API, not a replacement authority path.
not_established: Allocator requests and elapsed calls remain separate, unoptimized observations; API work differs and is not an interchangeable-operation speedup trial.
Transcript checks covered count, not full DTO equivalence; nonempty usage and complete model-context equality were not exercised.
Trace diagnostics are separate from timings and do not mean zero filesystem I/O.
Strict journal authority, validation and durable-before-effect guarantees were not weakened.
Public CI artifacts may expire; links identify the recorded run, not promised current artifact availability.

entries.title: Queued plus leased byte ownership
entries.accepted_scope: An authored deterministic queue model maintains admitted payload credits across dequeue and external consumer leases, with separate one-frame producer accounting and causal mutants. The Desktop producer/consumer path was source-inspected only.
entries.consumer: Desktop event pump and UI batch integration design.
not_established: Not a Desktop/Core/SSE parser implementation, runtime incident or deployed mitigation.
Logical payload ceilings are not RSS; decoding, buffer capacity, UI history and real scheduler yields remain separate.
A frame cap alone can reject legitimate large full-history baselines repeatedly; no arbitrary event-loss policy or production cap is recommended.
Model close/ack invariants do not prove real I/O cancellation or GPUI fairness.

entries.title: Cancellation, late outcomes and retry eligibility
entries.accepted_scope: Traced admission, intent, handler return, raw/final accepted results, cancellation and acknowledgement uncertainty across selected Core, Codex and OpenHands paths.
entries.consumer: Operators investigating an uncertain outcome before authorizing retry.
not_established: No lifecycle or foreign runtime execution in this study; proposed causal scenarios remain unrun.
A raw/effect-named record is not automatically a physical-effect receipt, and cancellation is not proof that no external effect occurred.
Broker bookkeeping settlement is not settlement of OS descendants; the cooperative grace timer is not hard preemption.
A lost acknowledgement does not authorize blind effectful retry.
